title: Tension expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) is correctly given as $F = m \omega^{2} L$.

title: Angular velocity relation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) is correctly given as $\omega = \sqrt{g/h}$.

title: Final distance answer
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) is correctly given as $s_0 = \frac{\sqrt{37}}{2} L$.

title: Force balance setup
description: Important: The solution correctly resolves forces into vertical and radial components, applying Newton's second law.

title: Geometry application
description: Important: The solution correctly relates the string length, cone height $h$, and radius of motion using trigonometry.

title: Break condition analysis
description: Important: For part (3), the solution correctly uses the maximum tension condition ($F_{max}=2mg$) to find the break angle and speed.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important: After the string breaks, the solution correctly analyzes the projectile's horizontal and vertical motion to find the landing point.

title: 3D distance calculation
description: Optional: The solution correctly uses the Pythagorean theorem in 3D to find the final distance $s_0$ from the landing point to the suspension point $O$.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: The student makes a sign error in force components or incorrectly handles units in the final expressions.

title: Geometry misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly relates the vertical height $h'$ of the ball above ground or the horizontal radius $r$ after the break.
